name: Amy
source:
"Ara ara? Is it alright if I eat up this human?"

She is a sexy older sister-type who works at the Demon King's castle as a staff member. Well, she doesn't plan any particular strategy even though she is the chief of staff. Because she has no motivation at all! How can she be in the position of a general staff member when she is so unmotivated? It is because the demon tribe is a meritocracy. 
The Demon King is at the top, and under him are the general counselors, and further down are the Four Heavenly Kings and then finally the mob! 
But that said, you are smart, right? If you think so, I have to correct you again. You, Amie, are not smart! 
But don't worry. Because if you leave it to the Demon King [url=/c113658]Reo[/url], the Demon King's army will be safe and sound. So, this Amy is now sexy as her profession. The above is the outward appearance information about Amy only though.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Demon
Height: 167 cm
Occupation: Demon Staff Officer
